title: Add the official Nginx GPG key and repository
objective: Import the necessary cryptographic key and add the Ubuntu 24.04 specific Nginx repository.
rationale: Adding the official repo ensures access to the latest stable version of Nginx compatible with Ubuntu 24.04 (Jammy).
expected_output: The GPG key is added and the repository source list entry is created.
success_criteria: The apt cache shows the new nginx package from the official repo.
